text: DSH Background Image 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的背景图插件。它在插件设置页和插件行配置页提供共同的图片设置面板，可选择或拖入图片，并在浏览器内缩放、重新编码后用于界面背景。用户可以实时调节背景不透明度和模糊程度，也能移除背景恢复原样。图片及设置保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage，插件通过主题令牌和固定背景层调整画布外观，适合希望个性化 DSH 网页界面的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Background Image adds a custom background to the DSH web UI. Users can choose or drop an image, adjust opacity and blur, or remove it from the plugin settings. Images are resized in the browser and saved with settings in localStorage. No API key or external service is needed.

DSH Background Image 的功能「图片导入」：用户可从文件选择器挑选图片，也可将图片拖入预览区域。客户端会在浏览器内缩放和重新编码，再将结果用于背景。
DSH Background Image 的功能「外观调节」：设置面板提供不透明度和虚化滑块，用户拖动后背景效果实时更新，数值分别限制在 0–100% 和 0–40 px。
DSH Background Image 的功能「主题背景层」：启用已保存图片时，客户端创建固定背景层并调整画布和侧栏的主题底色令牌；没有图片时移除这些效果。
DSH Background Image 的功能「移除背景」：用户可在设置面板移除已保存图片，插件清除图片记录并同步恢复未启用背景时的界面状态。
DSH Background Image 将压缩图片和外观设置写入当前浏览器的 localStorage；清除站点数据会删除这些内容。（见 client.js:292-306）

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · 特性：- **上传即用**：支持选择或拖入 JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF，浏览器内自动缩放、重新编码。
- **两个滑块**：背景不透明度（0–100%）与虚化程度（0–40 px），拖动实时生效。
- **主题自适应**：浅色 / 深色主题分别叠加白色、`#151517` 的主题色薄纱；切换主题自动跟随。
- **不改变布局**：背景是 `z-index: -1`、`pointer-events: none` 的固定层，不参与布局，也不拦截点击。
- **可读性优先**：只让主画布、会话区和侧栏的底色透明；卡片、输入框、弹层继续使用不透明表面。
- **本地存储**：图片压缩后保存在当前浏览器的 `localStorage`，不上传、不发起任何网络请求。
- **干净卸载**：插件禁用或卸载时清理样式、CSS 变量、令牌覆盖与类名，界面恢复原样。
- **双语界面**：设置页随 Harness 的界面语言显示中文或英文。

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · 存储与隐私：- 图片只保存在当前浏览器的 `localStorage`：
  - `dsh.background-image.image.v1`：压缩后的图片与尺寸；
  - `dsh.background-image.settings.v1`：不透明度与虚化值。
- 图片在浏览器内缩放至最长边 2560 px 并优先编码为 WebP，以适配本地存储配额。
- 插件不上传图片、不读取会话内容，也不发起任何网络请求。
- 清除站点数据或在设置页点击「移除背景」会删除已保存的图片。

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · 兼容性：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`
- 使用客户端服务：`ctx.slots`、`ctx.locale`、`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`
- 注册槽位：`settings.plugins.tab`、`plugins.row.config`
- 无构建步骤，`client.js` 直接以 Harness 的模块格式加载

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · 实现要点：- 背景层是 `html.dshbg-on body::before`：`position: fixed`、`inset: -180px`、
  `z-index: -1`、`pointer-events: none`；负 inset 为模糊边缘留出余量。
- 通过 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` 只覆盖两个颜色令牌：
  `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 与 `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`，把它们置为 `transparent`。
  其它表面继续使用 `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-*`，因此文字和控件的可读性不受影响。
- 不透明度映射到盖在照片上的主题色薄纱透明度；虚化作用于固定背景层本身。
- 设置页与插件行配置页共享同一个存储与表单组件。
- 所有样式、订阅与令牌覆盖都包在 `ctx.effect` 中，卸载时自动清理。

DSH Background Image

A lightweight client plugin that gives the DeepSeek Harness Web UI a custom background image.
Upload an image, tune opacity and blur — the appearance changes, never the layout.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Features：- **Upload and go** — pick or drop a JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF; it is scaled and
  re-encoded in the browser.
- **Two sliders** — background opacity (0–100%) and blur (0–40 px), applied live.
- **Theme aware** — a white veil in light mode and a `#151517` veil in dark mode;
  switching themes needs no action.
- **Layout safe** — a fixed `z-index: -1` / `pointer-events: none` layer that
  never joins layout or blocks clicks.
- **Readable** — only the canvas, conversation area and sidebar become
  transparent; cards, inputs and popovers keep their opaque surfaces.
- **Local only** — the compressed image is stored in this browser's
  `localStorage`; nothing is uploaded and no network request is made.
- **Clean uninstall** — disabling or removing the plugin disposes its styles,
  CSS variables, token overrides and class names.
- **Bilingual UI** — the settings page follows the Harness locale (Chinese or English).

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Install：The plugin is distributed through GitHub. Requires DeepSeek Harness
`>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · DSH Plugin Manager：```sh
git clone https://github.com/ASUKAq01/dsh-background-image.git
```

In Harness, open **Settings → Plugins**, use the local-directory install entry,
and select the cloned `dsh-background-image` directory. Enable it and refresh
the page once.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · `dsh` CLI：```sh
git clone https://github.com/ASUKAq01/dsh-background-image.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-background-image
```

Replace `<profile>` with your active profile (for example `desktop` or `web`),
then restart or refresh Harness.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · npm：Not published to npm yet. `package.json` already uses the name
`@asukaq01/dsh-background-image`, so once published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @asukaq01/dsh-background-image
```

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Usage：1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Background** (or the configuration entry on the
   plugin's row in the installed list).
2. Choose an image, or drop one onto the preview.
3. Adjust **Background opacity** and **Blur**; close Settings to see the full
   window effect.
4. **Remove** deletes the stored image and restores the original appearance.

> After the first install, refresh the page once so the browser loads the new
> client module.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Storage and privacy：- The image lives only in the current browser's `localStorage`:
  - `dsh.background-image.image.v1` — compressed image and dimensions;
  - `dsh.background-image.settings.v1` — opacity and blur.
- Images are scaled to a 2560 px longest edge and encoded as WebP when possible
  so they fit the local storage quota.
- The plugin uploads nothing, reads no session content and performs no network
  requests.
- Clearing site data or pressing **Remove** deletes the stored image.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`
- Client services: `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`
- Slots: `settings.plugins.tab`, `plugins.row.config`
- No build step; `client.js` loads directly in the Harness module format

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · How it works：- The background is `html.dshbg-on body::before`: `position: fixed`,
  `inset: -180px`, `z-index: -1`, `pointer-events: none`; the negative inset
  leaves room for blurred edges.
- `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` overrides exactly two color tokens:
  `--dsw-alias-bg-base` and `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` become
  `transparent`. Other surfaces keep `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-*`, so text and
  controls stay readable.
- Opacity maps to the alpha of a theme-colored veil above the photo; blur is
  applied to the fixed layer itself.
- The settings page and the plugin-row configuration page share one store and
  one form component.
- Every style, subscription and token override is registered through
  `ctx.effect`, so uninstalling cleans up automatically.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Development：No bundler or compiler. Install the repository directory into a profile and
refresh the page.

```sh
node scripts/validate.mjs
```

The validator checks `package.json` fields and export paths, both locale files,
the SVG icon and its size, the `cordis.patch.yml` row declaration, and the
syntax of `index.js` / `client.js`. GitHub Actions runs the same script on every
push and pull request.

@asukaq01/dsh-background-image README · Layout：```text
.
├── client.js               # all browser-side code (layer + settings page)
├── index.js                # empty Host half (a bundle needs a Host row)
├── cordis.patch.yml        # inserts the background-image row
